Package library

Class loan

java.lang.Object
library.loan
public class loan extends Object
Represents a loan transaction where a Member borrows a single Book for a fixed duration of 28 days.

This class keeps track of:

  • The borrowed book
  • The borrowing member
  • The borrowing date
  • The due date
  • Whether the book has been returned

  • Constructor Details

    • loan

      public loan(Book book, Member user)
      Creates a new loan for a given book and member. The due date is automatically set to 28 days after the borrow date.
      Parameters:
      book - the book being borrowed
      user - the member who is borrowing the book

      public boolean isOverdue()
      Determines whether the loan is overdue. A loan is overdue if the book is not returned and the current date is after the due date.
      Returns:
      true if overdue, otherwise false

    • overdueDays

      public long overdueDays()
      Calculates how many days the book is overdue. Returns 0 if the book has been returned or is not overdue.
      Returns:
      the number of overdue days

    • getOverdueDays

      public long getOverdueDays(LocalDate now)
      Returns the number of overdue days based on a given date. Useful for testing or custom date evaluation.
      Parameters:
      now - the date to compare with
      Returns:

    • isReturned2

      public void isReturned2()
      Marks the loan as returned and updates the book's availability status. Equivalent to completing the loan.
